question:
Which part of the following sentence contains a spelling error?

The physicist's controversial (1) treatise on quantum vacuums (2) was surprisingly well-recieved (3) by the academic board (4).
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'well-recieved'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'well-received'.**
 
• The word '**received**' is a **verb** which means 'to be given or presented with something'. **(प्राप्त करना)**
 
• The phrase 'well-received' means something that has been positively accepted or approved. **(अच्छी तरह स्वीकार किया गया)**

Correct sentence: *The physicist's controversial treatise on quantum vacuums was surprisingly well-received by the academic board.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Physicist -** a scientist who specializes in physics **(भौतिक विज्ञानी)**
 
• **Controversial -** giving rise or likely to give rise to public disagreement **(विवादास्पद)**
 
• **Treatise -** a written work dealing formally and systematically with a subject **(निबंध)**
 
• **Quantum Vacuums -** a scientific concept referring to the lowest energy state of a quantum field **(क्वांटम निर्वात)**
